title: devx SDK docs scratchpad - tutorial & sample-app TODOs
content:
Quick daily scratchpad for doc gaps, sample apps, and tutorial fixes. Mostly a brain dump + TODO list so I don't forget during sprint.

Context / goal:
- Improve onboarding flow for the Node + Python SDK quickstarts. Reduce time-to-first-run and avoid common environment issues.
- Add a minimal sample-app (chat + streaming) that demonstrates canary rollback hooks and error handling patterns.
- Fix missing/incorrect code snippets in 'auth & config' section (token renewal example, env var names).

Notes / problems spotted: 
- Quickstart Node guide still references old "RedwoodClient" constructor (legacy). Need to update to new builder pattern. Caused at least 2 Slack threads today.
- Python streaming example omits await on response.iter_text() loop -> hangs for some users. Repro steps in GH issue #298.
- Windows users hit permission error with default cache dir (~/.redwood/cache) because path handling isn't cross-platform in sample app. Need to add os.path.expanduser and fallback.
- Missing note about required model variants for embeddings vs chat in hosted API table (people try "text-embedding-ada" which isn't in catalog anymore).

TODOs (prioritized):
1) Update Node quickstart (high) - estimate 2-3h
   - Replace legacy constructor with RedwoodClient.builder() pattern + example config.json.
   - Add note about streaming: how to handle backpressure (simple example).
   - Add link to Node SDK API reference.
   - Assign: Alex to PR code + unit test for example.
   - Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/342

2) Fix Python streaming example (high) - estimate 1-2h
   - Add proper async iterator usage and example with try/except for CancelledError.
   - Add Windows path handling snippet for cache dir.
   - Add short troubleshooting section: common error messages and fixes.
   - Assign: Mikaela to submit PR, Devon to review.

3) Create minimal sample-app (chat + streaming + rollback demo) (med) - estimate 2 days
   - Example features: streaming messages, function/tool calling, error + fallback to smaller model, canary deploy simulation via env var.
   - Repo layout proposal: /examples/sample-chat-app/{node,python}/README.md, Dockerfile, CI snippet.
   - Tasks: scaffold Node app (Alex), copy pattern to Python (Mikaela), write README with step-by-step deploy instructions (me).

4) Docs accuracy pass (med) - estimate 4h spread across team
   - Verify model names in catalog table and add note about pinned versions.
   - Add token-cost estimate callout for each example (rough tokens/sec and cost metrics).
   - Add links to relevant console dashboards (rollouts, telemetry).

5) Add end-to-end tutorial (low) - estimate 3 days
   - Target: new dev can finish in 45 min, covers auth, quickstart, sample-app, and simple eval.
   - Include a small test prompt set and expected outputs for regression checks.

Quick wins (do today):
- PR small patch to Node quickstart to swap constructor + add note (30-45m).
- Add Windows cache snippet to Python example (15-20m).
- Post short note in #devx on Slack linking PRs and asking for reviewers.

Open questions / decisions needed: 
- Do we want sample-apps in main repo under /examples or in a separate org repo for easier CI? (Pros/cons: example infra churn vs discoverability).
- Should we include built-in rollback simulation code or keep it conceptual in README? I prefer small env-var-triggered fallback so it runs locally without infra.
- What’s the priority for adding token-cost callouts? Ops wants it in all public examples but that adds maintenance overhead.

Links / refs: 
- GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/issues/298 (python streaming)
- GH PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-sdk/pull/342 (node quickstart)
- Jira: DX-289 (sample-app epic)
- Internal convo: slack #devx thread (link pinned in PR description)

Notes to self: 
- When updating quickstarts, run them in fresh container (ubuntu:22.04) to catch env assumptions.
- Add small test harness that asserts examples return expected keys (id, model, tokens) so we don't ship broken snippets.
- Remember to bump docs version in frontmatter when changing code samples to avoid caching old HTML on CDN.

Meeting follow-ups: 
- 2026-03-05 10am: sync with Alex + Mikaela to split sample-app work (calendar invite sent).
- Ask Product for a short blurb on recommended models for embedding vs chat (we need wording for public docs).

Random scratch notes: 
- Consider adding a short troubleshooting CLI: redwood-check --run-quickstart that validates env, token, model availability. Could be nano-CLI in examples.
- Might include a small section on Private deployment quirks (KMS env var names differ).

End of scratchpad.
